definitions.explanation: Widely known and recognized, especially for achievements or expertise. A formal word used mainly in writing and formal speech.

examples.japanese: {著名|ちょめい}な{建築家|けんちくか}がデザインした。
examples.english: It was designed by a renowned architect.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はその{分野|ぶんや}で{著名|ちょめい}な{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is a prominent researcher in that field.

examples.japanese: {世界的|せかいてき}に{著名|ちょめい}な{指揮者|しきしゃ}を{招|まね}いてコンサートが{開催|かいさい}された。
examples.english: A concert was held with a world-renowned conductor as guest.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-style word. In everyday conversation, {有名|ゆうめい} is far more common. {著名|ちょめい} implies being well known for notable achievements or expertise, while {有名|ゆうめい} is broader and can include fame from any cause (including notoriety).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Prenominal: {著名|ちょめい}な + noun ({著名|ちょめい}な{学者|がくしゃ})
- Pattern: ～で{著名|ちょめい}: famous for ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著名|ちょめい}な{人物|じんぶつ}: notable figure
- {著名|ちょめい}な{学者|がくしゃ}: renowned scholar
- {著名|ちょめい}な{作家|さっか}: noted writer
- {世界的|せかいてき}に{著名|ちょめい}: world-renowned
- {著名人|ちょめいじん}: famous person, celebrity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有名|ゆうめい}: famous — the everyday word; broader and more casual
- {高名|こうめい}: renowned, illustrious — more literary, implies high reputation
